statement: The lean parameter subset for a fixed finite Y_tilde is a convex set.
assumptions: X and Y are compact subsets of Euclidean spaces
a parameter is lean when every support branch attains the finite maximum at some x
quantifiers: For every fixed admissible X, finite Y_tilde, and Phi, for every two lean parameter vectors and every lambda in [0,1], their convex combination is lean.
falsification_gate: One exact instance satisfying all assumptions, with two independently checked lean endpoints and a strictly nonlean convex combination.
